marks.gloss_en: as honoring parents does not override even the karet-free lav of מחמר, so no aseh overrides any lav
מה להנך שכן הכשר מצוה -- driving the animal is mere preparation for the mitzva, not the mitzva act itself, so nothing follows for genuine mitzva acts
no -- the baraita speaks of the lav of מחמר, which carries no karet; nothing follows about karet-level prohibitions
